name: Map caption: the pins are the number
when: A big count tied to the map (species, places, locations). The pins pop, slowly at first, then a flood; the number counts them and lands, then the suffix and the source come.
anchor: The number fades in at 0.2 s and counts until 2.93 s; the suffix comes at 3.03 s. Start the scene so the count lands as the voice says the number.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.number: the number the count lands on (1 to 9999). With one pin per unit (as validated: 170 pins, 170) the count is the pin count; with fewer pins it steps in proportion
vars.suffix: shown after the number once it lands ("+"); empty = none
vars.unit: what is counted, in capitals as validated ("ANIMAL SPECIES"); 16 characters at most
vars.source: who says it, as a sentence ("Confirmed by Rockstar"); empty = no source line. 32 characters at most so it stays clear of the pins
vars.map: the map image. Every position below is in pixels of this file at its natural size (map pixels). Empty = the map the skill ships: gta-map/maps/leonida.jpg, the whole state (its bounds are in gta-map/maps/maps.json).
vars.pins: x,y pairs in map pixels, space separated ("1864.5,3177.2 1955.4,3057.5 ..."), in popping order: the first ones pop alone, then they flood. Default: the 170 validated land points on the lab map (mapdemo/assets/map/overview.jpg). They are illustrative, not real locations: the voice must not say they are
vars.cam_x: map x at the frame centre when the scene starts
vars.cam_y: map y at the frame centre when the scene starts
vars.zoom: scale when the scene starts: 1 = one map pixel per screen pixel. The pins keep the same size on screen
vars.cam_x2: map x at the frame centre when the scene ends: the camera pushes from start to end over the whole scene (sine in-out)
vars.cam_y2: map y at the frame centre when the scene ends
vars.out: seconds after the start: when the caption leaves (at least 3.8, after the source lands). The scene ends 0.3 s later, on the map

source: algrow-gta-pipeline/lab/mapextras/compositions/mcc.html (validated as mapcaption-C2, the redo of mapcaption-C)
changed: None in the validated motion. Additions: the map, the pins and the camera are variables in map pixels; the count takes thousands separators (3,000) and steps in proportion when `number` is larger than the pin count (with the defaults it is the validated count, one per pin).
